proposal.expected_benefit: This change will ensure that audit and compliance enforcement are consistently aligned with the actual control implementation, reducing the risk of bypasses and improving the robustness of mandatory controls.
proposal.problem: The contradiction between audit status and compliance decisions may allow bypasses if audit and compliance enforcement are not fully aligned with the actual control implementation.
proposal.proposed_change: Implement a dynamic audit-compliance alignment mechanism that ensures audit status is explicitly enforced before any compliance decision is made. This mechanism should include real-time validation of audit anchors and compliance gates to prevent any bypasses due to misalignment.
proposal.title: Align Audit and Compliance Enforcement with Control Implementation
verification_tests: Validate that audit anchors are enforced before compliance decisions are made.
Check for any bypasses when audit status is misaligned with compliance decisions.
